clips.title: The story
paras: Flame Crest is a rugged neutral outpost perched atop a rocky ledge overlooking the volcanic wastes of the Burning Steppes. Accessed only across a crude span, this precarious encampment serves as a forward staging ground against the Dark Horde entrenched in Blackrock Mountain. It provides essential aerial connections and a haven for scouts, beast collectors, and strategists.

Situated high on an isolated stone outcropping, Flame Crest commands a watchful view over the scorched ash and lava plains of the Burning Steppes. Reached only by crossing a narrow, rickety wooden bridge, the outpost is naturally defensible against the prowling beasts and roaming orc warbands of the wastes. Wind riders roost along the heights, connecting the camp back across the Redridge range to Kargath, Stonard, Thorium Point, and Rog'mar in the Riverglades.

Flame Crest is more than just a wind rider roost; it is a critical forward watchpoint over the Blackrock clan entrenched within Blackrock Spire. Here, deep in hostile territory, scouts gather intelligence, lay plans to break the renegade Dark Horde, and trade with eccentric loners like the pet master Kibler in his nearby cave.
